visualCharacteristics.purpose: Shadowed panel listing dated headline links with CTA buttons
visualCharacteristics.layout: Single panel; becomes the aside column of a directly preceding cards block
notable: Each feed item row is one link with date and time
Bold links are primary, italic links secondary buttons
Authored snapshot of a CMS news list

contentPattern.structure: A heading row for the title, then item rows with date, time and a headline link paragraph, then a row of CTA link paragraphs
contentPattern.rows: Title row, one row per feed item, CTA row

usage: Use for a short list of latest news headlines beside a news cards grid
reuseGuidance: Fits dated headline links with a few CTAs; not for items with images or teaser text
